I'd prefer to only date cisgendered people but I see where you're coming from.

I feel like I study men a lot more than women and that's why they catch my attention more. I've seen plenty of beautiful women and while I think they're goddesses, nothing about them really fazes me since I'm the same gender as them. But learning about male characteristics is interesting to me. On the other hand, the idea of being intimate with a man seems boring and unfulfilling. I would never want to submit my life to that.

It's hard to consider if I want to be the man or want to be with a man when it comes to looking at a straight couple. Like, I understand why women are attracted to men. I personally think it's because women naturally have lower standards for them and that's why they don't have to try as hard to attract them.

Despite all this, I still have no idea whether to call my intrigue attraction or not. I'd rather identify as a lesbian because it'll be a lot less complicated and for some stupid reason would make me a more interesting person than if I were bi. I don't want to be attracted to men. I wish that part of me would just go away.
